source_model_assumption: Official Unitree G1 equivalence only. Existing local meshes were reused to compile the official XML, not independently validated as official mesh bytes. This does not establish the BONES generation model, original FBX hierarchy or retarget quality.

q1_assets.action_scale_basis: 0.25 * full_model_effort / kp; independent of trial torque cap
q1_assets.control_scope: simulation only; not manufacturer-verified hardware gains

contact_protocol.semantics: Foot contact friction follows the episode context; R01 assets remain separate.
